title: Signature Duo 05 · Glamour Hourglass × USSBBW · Irezumi Cherry × Irezumi Waves · Cream Studio
prompt:
Subject: TWO Black women standing side by side, clearly separated with no overlap, a dramatic contrast of an impossibly tiny waist and extreme soft volume.

Skin: Both women have THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, their faces the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat.

Left woman — mid 30s, long glossy waves with gold kanzashi combs. Glamour hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an overwhelmingly enormous full bust, a waist cinched so impossibly tiny it is barely a third of the width of her hips, hips flaring to nearly twice the width of her shoulders, thighs thicker than her waist pressing together, soft full voluptuous curves everywhere. Not skinny, not a runway model. Body Art: Full body Japanese irezumi body painting painted directly on bare skin from neck to ankle. A bright indigo and white swirling wave ground with vivid pink, vermilion, and gold cherry blossom branches, one continuous design flowing diagonally across the torso. The waves and blossoms spread wide across the bust and hips and narrow across the tiny waistline. Not black shading, no dragons, no koi. Densely filled, covering the arms and legs completely.

Right woman — late 30s, sleek high bun with red lacquer kanzashi. USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 800 pounds — an enormous soft apron belly hanging in several heavy overlapping rolls down to mid-thigh, deep creases between each roll, not pregnant, a gigantic bust resting on the belly, no waist at all, deep side rolls, hips wider than a normal woman's whole torso, huge thighs pressed together, enormous soft upper arms. Body Art: Full body Japanese irezumi body painting painted directly on bare skin from neck to ankle. A bright indigo and white ground of continuous curling white-crested waves with vermilion and gold wind bars and scattered cherry petals. The waves cover the whole body, each belly roll carrying its own curling white-crested wave, darker pigment settling into each deep crease. Not black shading, no dragons, no koi. Densely filled, covering the arms and legs completely.

Pose: The left woman — standing in a wide stance with a strong hip shift, one hand resting lightly on her outer thigh, the other arm hanging relaxed away from the body. The right woman — standing full frontal with her feet planted far apart, arms relaxed slightly away from the body, never covering the belly, so every roll is fully visible.

Footwear & Nails: The left woman wears extremely high pink lacquer platform stiletto mules; the right woman wears extremely high vermilion lacquer platform stiletto mules. Extra long nails.

Background & Lighting: A seamless warm cream studio backdrop with no props, the background much lighter than their bodies, soft warm light from one side carving the impossibly tiny waist on the left and deep shadows between each belly roll on the right, making the materials gleam, bright highlights on every glossy curve. 3:4 vertical 8K portrait, camera at waist height, 35mm lens.
